data.case_title: Voluntary Health Insurance Contribution Notice – Allgemeine Musterkasse
data.title: Contribution assessment (Beitragsbescheid) for voluntary health insurance
data.summary: The Allgemeine Musterkasse (statutory health insurer) confirms voluntary membership for Mara Beispiel starting 01.06.2026 and sets the monthly contribution at 530,85 € (412,65 € health insurance + 118,20 € long-term care insurance), collected by direct debit on the 15th of the following month.
data.explanation: This letter is an official decision (Bescheid) from your health insurer fixing your monthly contribution for voluntary membership. The amount will be taken automatically from your account by direct debit each month, so you don't need to transfer it yourself. If you disagree with the calculated amount, you can file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing, electronically, or in person at the insurer's office by the deadline shown. If you take no action, the assessed contribution stands and continues to be collected. Since this affects social insurance contributions, keep it for your tax return, as it may be deductible.

key_facts.label: Start of voluntary membership
key_facts.quote: ab dem 01.06.2026 sind Sie bei uns freiwillig versichert.

key_facts.label: Total monthly contribution
key_facts.quote: Auf Grundlage Ihrer Einkommensnachweise setzen wir die Beiträge wie folgt fest: Krankenversicherung 412,65 €, Pflegeversicherung 118,20 € – insgesamt 530,85 € monatlich.

key_facts.label: Collection method
key_facts.quote: Die Beiträge werden jeweils zum 15. des Folgemonats per Lastschrift eingezogen.
